verdict.rationale: Firecrawl explicitly documents batch scraping thousands of URLs asynchronously (firecrawl-gh-5), backed by webhooks for async event delivery/status notifications instead of polling (firecrawl-docs-7, firecrawl-docs-11), and crawl/discover-all-URLs features to feed batch jobs (firecrawl-gh-3, firecrawl-gh-4). Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks confirming reliability at true 'thousands of URLs' scale, and no rate-limit/throughput SLA details beyond docs claims.
